info.name: Moniewise Backend
info.description:
Session-authenticated REST for the Moniewise Spring Boot API.

**Import both** this collection and `Moniewise-Local.postman_environment.json`.

1. Set `baseUrl` (local `http://localhost:8080` or your Render host).
2. Fill `email` / `password` (and `pin` for money moves).
3. Run **Login** — tests write `accessToken` onto the collection and environment.
4. Remaining folders inherit `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

Public folders disable auth. `/admin/**` needs an admin JWT. Wrong-user AI thread/action lookups return **404**, not 403.

Empty controller stubs (`GamificationController`, `InsightsController`, `GoalController`) have no mappings and are omitted.

item.name: 00 Public — no JWT
item.description: World-readable surfaces. Auth is disabled on these requests.

request.description: Budget minimum and currency for the client.

item.name: 01 Auth
item.description: Signup is Redis+OTP then JWT. Login may return 403 OTP verification required unless X-Device-Id is trusted or the account is a test reviewer account.

request.description: 201 — OTP emailed. No user row yet.
Creates the user and returns JWT.
Saves token to collection + environment. Send a stable X-Device-Id after OTP so this device is trusted.
May return status=withdrawal_required if wallet still has funds.

item.name: 02 Users & profile
item.description: JWT required except OTP endpoints above.

item.name: 04 Transaction PIN
item.description: 4-digit PIN. Rate-limited. Needed for withdrawals, VAS, envelope transfers, AI confirm.

item.name: 10 Transactions
item.description: POST /transactions/transfer uses query params, not JSON.

item.name: 14 Legal (in-app JSON)
item.description: /legal/** requires JWT. HTML pages are in Public.

item.name: 15 Gemini AI (legacy /ai)
item.description: Separate from in-process Monnie SDK. Volume-limited (20/hour except dashboard).

item.name: 16 Monnie SDK chat (/ai/sdk)
item.description: Session JWT. Wrong-user thread/action → 404. Instructions persist on the thread; later turns cannot swap them. PIN confirm does not execute from the SDK itself.

request.description: Instructions only apply while the thread currently has none.

item.name: 18 Admin
item.description: Requires ROLE_ADMIN (JWT with admin role). URL prefix /admin/** is also gated in SecurityConfig.

item.name: 19 Webhooks (providers — no JWT)
item.description: Open in SecurityConfig. Signatures are provider-specific. Bodies are placeholders — do not use as production replay.
